notes.text: Chronic conditions reviewed and stable. Continue current plan.
Carlota needed hands-on help getting out of the tub today and said she has been skipping showers because she is afraid of slipping.

ADL reassessment. Carlota now needs moderate assistance with bathing and lower-body dressing; independent at last review. Recommend tub transfer bench, handheld shower, and increasing home care hours for bathing support.
Routine check. Vitals within her usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.
Carlota enjoyed the gardening group and talked about growing tomatoes as a child.

Seen at partner hospital emergency department on Nov 2, 2026 for chest pain; cardiac workup negative; treated and released the same day. No new medications at discharge. Follow up with PACE primary care within 7 days.
Carlota attended day center, joined chair exercise and music group, and ate most of lunch.
Assisted with light housekeeping and meal prep. Carlota in good spirits.
Post-hospital follow-up for chest pain; cardiac workup negative. Carlota is back to baseline per her son. Reviewed discharge medications. Will monitor closely over the next two weeks.

Weight 69.0 kg, down from 73.5 kg on Sep 5, 2026 (6%). Carlota reports poor appetite and skipping breakfast. Eating about 50% of day center lunches. Plan: oral nutrition supplement twice daily, weekly weights, and dental check for chewing problems.

Rosa reports Carlota has been more confused in the evenings for about two weeks, once leaving the stove on. Oriented to person and place today but not date. No fever. Plan: urinalysis, medication review, and PCP visit this week.
